assessments.reasoning: The FSF's 1.3 §9 at [17885,19211) places the first-notice rule between the cessation and recipient provisions. Its third paragraph expressly ties prior notice to the same holder across works and timely cure to receipt.

limitations: The record establishes the rule. Applying it requires the holder's identity, notice history, reasonable means, receipt time and cure time.
reasoning: GNU FDL 1.3 §9 permanently reinstates the license from the notifying holder when that holder gives notice by reasonable means, the licensee has never before received notice from that holder of a violation of this license for any work, and the licensee cures before 30 days have elapsed from receipt.
